opening: I have been noticing unusual writing on the wall.
It lasts less than a minute.
It's not clear, and I can't read it most of the time.

opening.text: I've been noticing some unusual writing on the wall. It started yesterday, and each time it lasts less than a minute. The writing isn't really clear, and I can't read it most of the time.
